inspiration: Deterministic frame step: the frame counter advances, then the frame is processed, then triggers run (bwgame.h:13191-13194). This is the fixed-step shape for row 18 (server tick).

Seeded random source with per-source counters: a linear congruential generator with a fixed multiplier and an increment (bwgame.h:13197-13201) and a counter per random source (bwgame.h:237). Idea: give each system its own random stream and count the draws, so a desync can be found.

Staggered order processing: units are dealt processing buckets 0 to 7 that are re-dealt every 150 frames (bwgame.h:12879-12887). Spreads AI decisions across frames: the per-tick NPC budget idea in row 18.
Lockstep scheduling: actions are stamped with an 8-bit frame tag and run when the sync frame matches (sync.h:191-195). Compact stamps; wrap-around must be handled.

Replay as recorded actions: each replay frame executes the stored actions, then advances the state; playing past the end is an error (replay.h:229-230). Matches the fight record and replay row 19. Re-express with our own input log.
Sound call shape: a play call takes a channel, a sound, a volume and a stereo pan (ui/native_sound.h:13). Pan per combat cue is the sound-music idea to borrow.
Typed loaders per table: separate loaders for units, weapons, upgrades and flingy data (data_loading.h:1440, 1518, 1564, 1629). Catalogue-as-runtime-source, rows 20 and 21.

briefs.label: Lockstep ghost replay (own label)
briefs.why: A fight can be watched again from a log of inputs, so a memorable moment can be shown back at the same timing. Behaviour idea only: the box has no art.
briefs.keep: Per-frame action log; the same engine re-runs the log; a clear error when the log ends
briefs.change: We log player inputs only, add a camera path and a scrubber, and show a distinct original ghost fighter; no trait copied from the donor

briefs.label: Staggered-think fighters (own label)
briefs.why: Many enemies can decide their next step without all deciding on the same frame, which keeps frame time flat with a crowd on screen.
briefs.keep: Fixed set of processing buckets; buckets re-dealt on a long timer
briefs.change: Buckets come from the zone and spawn id, tied to the per-tick budget of row 18; our own rhythm, not the donor's 150-frame value
